discipline: AUDIT-FIRST. Audited the reorganized HEAD, reused every existing primitive, implemented only genuine gaps, and did NOT report any preset as implemented unless its execution is wired and test-proven on this HEAD.

delivered.note: 16 capabilities classified DONE/PARTIAL/MISSING with file:line evidence. Key finding: ~half the selective primitives already existed (two profiles, download-only, translation kill-switch, output_format, re-export YK reuse).

delivered.item: Unified OutputPlan contract (single source of truth)
delivered.note: Operations {translate,clean,typeset,pdf,psd,qc} + 7 presets + normalize_output_plan() with transitive dependency rules, mapping each plan onto the EXISTING config knobs (translation_enabled/download_only/output_profile/output_format). CLEAN is provider-agnostic (no gemini/oracle/chrome branching). Runnable demo() self-check.

Render couples clean-capture and text burn-in, so translation-without-typeset cannot run yet. apenas_traducao and traducao_clean are valid plans with executable=false and are rejected at submission with a clear error. They are NOT reported as implemented.

_normalize_payload honours an optional output_plan preset, overriding the scattered knobs and reusing all proven plumbing; rejects non-executable plans. Every job record carries output_plan/requested_operations/effective_operations (inferred for legacy jobs via plan_from_config) for truthful finish-screen filtering.

build_artifact_manifest records output_plan/requested_operations/effective_operations (omitted on legacy runs); job_runner propagates them via env (YOMU_OUTPUT_PLAN/REQUESTED_OPS/EFFECTIVE_OPS); the pipeline reads them at manifest build.

22 tests: dependency rules, knob mapping, executability, legacy round-trip, ui_bridge override+rejection, manifest fields, and the decisive guarantee — CLEAN-only initializes NO provider and the YK commit is guarded by translation_enabled (provider-spy + YK-invariant proof at the real boundary).
Preset table with honest state (IMPLEMENTADO vs PLANEJADO), dependency rules, the 0-YK rationale, provider-agnostic CLEAN note, legacy compatibility, and the scoped next steps.

scoped_followups_not_faked: UI preset surface + custom selector (backend already accepts output_plan from any client).
Execution for apenas_traducao (skip-render + translation manifest) and traducao_clean (clean without typeset burn) -- both need the render stage decoupled.
Finish-screen NOT_REQUESTED filtering and progress NOT_REQUESTED semantics (job records now carry effective_operations to drive it).
